abstract: Maintains dock draft depth and sample cold storage certification records
system_message:
You are Expedition logistics coordinator (LOG). You serve as the expedition logistics coordinator (LOG), responsible for maintaining dock draft depths, hydrographic access specifications, and specimen cold storage certification records for sub-Antarctic marine staging bases.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains dock draft depth and sample cold storage certification records（STG）
information_points.content:
LOG-STG-2JX：For Kerguelen Marine Research Haven under the operational deployment environment, cold storage certification is confirmed, and the minimum harbor draft depth across the berth fairway and turnaround basin is 12 m.
LOG-STG-AZ6：For Kerguelen Marine Research Haven evaluated under the simulation test environment, cold storage certification is met, but the recorded harbor draft depth is 9 m.
LOG-STG-NY3：For South Georgia Staging Facility under the operational deployment environment, cold storage certification is verified, and the minimum harbor draft depth reaches 14 m.
LOG-STG-BLI：For Falkland Sound Support Depot under the operational deployment environment, cold storage certification is not held, while the minimum harbor draft depth is 12 m.

information_points.title: Deep freeze storage（CHILL）
information_points.content:
LOG-CHILL-ROP：At Falkland Sound Support Depot, telemetry records indicate a deep freeze temperature stability of -60 degC in the biological archive freezers.
LOG-CHILL-0HF：At Kerguelen Marine Research Haven, telemetry logs show a deep freeze temperature stability of -70 degC sustained across biological archive freezers.
LOG-CHILL-EIZ：At South Georgia Staging Facility, cryogenic telemetry confirms a deep freeze temperature stability of -80 degC within the biological archive freezers.
